text: I have carved seals and maintained the Citadel's stonework since my apprenticeship ended.
Every seal I carve bears the Signs, though I cannot read a single one of them.
No one alive can read the Signs. Not me, not Ren, not anyone in any Harappan city I've heard traders describe.
The Citadel platform shows at least three distinct construction phases in its brickwork.
The outermost, thickest layer of brick was added after a period I believe corresponds to the Turning.
I think the Citadel was reinforced not for defense against people, but to reassure a frightened population.
Ren studies the Signs carved into these same walls. We disagree about what the carvings mean, but not about their age.
Yara won't fire brick faster than her kilns safely allow, which slows my repair work.
I've stopped pushing her on it. She's right to hold the line.
Sena's oral-history timeline matches my building-phase evidence closely enough to be unsettling.
The covered drains beneath the Lower Town were expanded in the same period as the outer Citadel wall.
Something during the Turning required both stronger walls and better water management, urgently.
Elira once showed me an old tally that referenced a Citadel wing that no longer exists.
I have found no trace of that wing anywhere on the mound. It may be buried, or it may have simply been erased from memory along with her records.
I trust stone over stories, but even stone has been telling me the story matches Elira's records.
